# Image

Image with a placeholder while loading, a fallback when loading fails, and a larger preview on click. The preview
opens from the position of the image onto a neutral viewer background (the `viewer-*` tokens, the viewer
background step of ThemeProvider), so the colors of the image are not affected by the theme. For many images use
ImageGrid and Lightbox.

**Interaction**: the image fades in when it has loaded. With preview, the image is a button: `Tab` focuses it and
shows the focus ring, and a click or `Enter` / `Space` open the preview. In the preview, focus stays inside it,
`Esc` closes it, and focus returns to the image.

**Category**: Media · **Common uses**: Thumbnails in detail pages and forms, cover images, images in messages

## Import

```ts
import { Image } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Give the image a `width` and `height`: the placeholder keeps the area while it loads, then the image fades in.
Click it, or press `Enter`, to open the preview on the neutral viewer background.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return <Image src={first?.src} alt={first?.alt} width={160} height={120} />
}
```

## Variants

### Fit, radius and no preview

`fit="contain"` shows the whole image, `radius` sets the corners and `preview={false}` turns off the preview.

```tsx
export function Variants() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={4}>
      <Image src={second?.src} alt={second?.alt} width={160} height={96} fit="contain" />
      <Image src={second?.src} alt={second?.alt} width={96} height={96} radius="lg" />
      <Image
        src={first?.src}
        alt={first?.alt}
        width={96}
        height={96}
        radius="none"
        preview={false}
      />
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## States

### Loading and failed

While loading, a neutral placeholder covers the area; when the image fails to load, a fallback replaces it and the
image cannot be previewed.

```tsx
export function States() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={4}>
      {/* An image that cannot be decoded: fails without a network request */}
      <Image src="data:image/png;base64,AAAA" alt="Missing photo" width={160} height={120} />
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | Address of the image, passed to `<img>` as it is. | — | No |
| `alt` | `string` | Text alternative of the image, read by screen readers; it is also the accessible name of the preview button. Use an empty string only for decorative images without preview. | — | No |
| `placeholder` | `ReactNode` | Shown over the image area while it loads: a neutral fill by default; `false` shows nothing. Give the image a `width` and `height` so that the area keeps its size while loading. | `true` | No |
| `fallback` | `ReactNode` | Shown instead of the image when it fails to load: an image icon and the built-in text ("Failed to load") by default. A failed image cannot be previewed. | — | No |
| `preview` | `boolean \| ImagePreviewOptions` | Opens a larger preview on click or `Enter` / `Space`; `false` turns it off. The object form sets the address of the preview and makes it controlled. | `true` | No |
| `fit` | `'cover' \| 'contain'` | How the image fills a `width` × `height` area: `cover` crops it, `contain` shows all of it. | `'cover'` | No |
| `radius` | `'none' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Corner radius: `md` for thumbnails in lists and forms, `lg` for cards, `none` for images that fill an area. | `'md'` | No |

Also accepts the props of the corresponding Ant Design component (`ImageProps`), except `style` and `className`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
